title: Nordic alien on Orcas Island
summary: Brent Freriedman tells of Nordic alien on Orcas Island, about unspecified at Washington, D.C., and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

as_told.title: Nordic-looking being on Orcas Island speaks to Brent without moving his mouth

plain: Brent Friedman is a Hollywood writer. On the podcast of host Jesse Michels, he says he once saw a Nordic alien on Orcas Island, in Washington state. A Nordic alien is a term for a being said to look like a tall, fair human. He gives no date. In a fuller telling on the same episode, he says it happened on a friend's 20-acre property. All of a sudden, he says, there was a person who looked just like a Scandinavian male model. He says the being spoke to him without moving its mouth. If true, it would mean beings that pass for human can show up and talk by thought. Both tellings are Brent's own, from one conversation, the second adding the details.
